items.title: Neighborhood House Association (Portland, OR) claimed by The Gentlemen
items.summary: The Gentlemen ransomware group has claimed responsibility for a cyberattack on the Portland nonprofit; the claim has not been confirmed by the victim.

items.title: Synology urges DSM updates after ransomware hits NAS devices
items.summary: Synology is urging customers to patch DiskStation Manager following ransomware attacks against its network-attached storage devices, a common backup target.

items.title: U.S. biopharmaceutical company claimed in Nov 2 leak-site post
items.summary: A ransomware group posted a claim on November 2 against an unnamed U.S. biopharmaceutical firm; victim identity and impact are unconfirmed.

items.title: Fox Hill Bookkeeping & Tax Practice (All Business Technologies) — n0n
items.summary: SOCRadar lists an n0n-group claim against the bookkeeping and tax practice with an attack date of October 18, 2026.

items.title: UK NCSC: AI-enabled ransomware on critical infrastructure 'highly likely'
items.summary: A November 3 NCSC assessment warns it is highly likely AI malware will be used in a ransomware attack on UK critical national infrastructure.

ransomware.note: Only four days into November — leak-site trackers and press lag, so named-victim volume is light; one late-October claim included for context.

items.title: SkyBell DNS outage logs users out, drops devices offline
items.summary: SkyBell reported devices going offline and app logouts from November 2, attributed on November 3 to DNS server settings, with no ETA given.

items.title: Cloudflare: Durable Object errors in Dallas, 5xx spike in Hong Kong
items.summary: Cloudflare logged elevated Durable Object errors in its Dallas region (resolved 16:42 UTC) and elevated 5xx errors in HKG (resolved 06:32 UTC) on November 3.

items.title: W. W. Norton digital platform data-display issue
items.summary: Norton's status page reported student time-spent data being logged but not appearing on the ebook landing page on November 3.

outage.note: No major AWS, Azure or Google Cloud incident reported so far in November; Google Search dashboard clear as of Nov 3.

items.title: CISA adds WordPress Core race condition CVE-2026-119977 to KEV
items.summary: A CVSS 8.1 TOCTOU flaw in WordPress Core exploited during upgrades to achieve code execution; FCEB agencies must patch by November 6.

items.title: WordPress Core exploitation confirmed in the wild
items.summary: CISA confirmed attackers are exploiting the WordPress Core flaw during software upgrades, putting a huge install base at risk.

items.title: Ivanti Connect Secure CVE-2026-111357 added to KEV
items.summary: CISA added an actively exploited Ivanti Connect Secure flaw and CVE-2026-118527 to the catalog on October 30.

items.title: Chainstack discloses infrastructure breach
items.summary: The blockchain infrastructure provider disclosed on November 3 that an unauthorized party accessed parts of its infrastructure.

items.title: Hacktivists claim destruction of Rosstat internal systems
items.summary: Belarusian Cyber Partisans and Silent Crow claimed to wipe Russia's statistics agency systems; Rosstat confirmed attacks Oct 29–Nov 1 but denies database compromise.

items.title: CISA adds six KEVs including Plex Media Server flaws
items.summary: On October 20 CISA added six actively exploited flaws, mostly in Plex Media Server plus EG Secure Solutions and Siemens products.

items.title: San Juan River flooding forces evacuations in New Mexico and Colorado
items.summary: Heavy rain sent the San Juan River surging, with evacuations in San Juan County, NM and mandatory orders in Archuleta County, CO; at least one death reported.

items.title: Pagosa Springs braces for possible historic river crest
items.summary: Residents and businesses were urged to evacuate as the San Juan River was forecast to crest Tuesday–Wednesday; a house was swept into a bridge on November 2.

items.title: Arizona flash flooding prompts Sedona and Camp Verde evacuations
items.summary: Urgent evacuation orders were issued for zones in Sedona and voluntary evacuation encouraged in Camp Verde amid flash flooding and road closures.

items.title: Typhoon In-fa brings dangerous surf to the Marianas and Guam
items.summary: An October 29 warning forecast 12–18 ft surf on Tinian and Saipan and 10–14 ft on Guam and Rota through the weekend.

items.title: M 6.4 earthquake southeast of Easter Island
items.summary: USGS recorded a M 6.4 quake on October 29 in the remote southeast Pacific; green alert, no tsunami.

physical.note: No active wildfire evacuations found; U.S. Southwest flooding is the main BC event this week.
